recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for this old ImagingManifest request unless the Imaging WG files a new current-scope issue for active ImagingStudy or ImagingSelection wording.
issue_request: FHIR-6245 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core-ImagingManifest change request to add hyperlinks to referenced WADO and DICOM standards, with resolution text saying DICOM Standard specification links would be added to Scope and Usage.
initial_application: No explicit source commit mentioning FHIR-6245 was found. The closest historical source trail is an August 2015 imaging update that added DICOM Part 6, Part 3, and Part 4 links to ImagingStudy Scope and Usage; later ImagingManifest endpoint work added WADO-URI/WADO-RS guidance before the artifact was retired.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini now lists ImagingStudy and ImagingSelection as active resources and lists imagingmanifest/ImagingObjectSelection in the deleted-resource section. Later Jira decisions resolved WADO-rendering guidance as covered by prior CPs, moved endpoint guidance toward ImagingStudy, and created ImagingSelection as the current selected-image resource family.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing the retired ImagingManifest source would not affect the current build, and adding more links to active pages would be redundant with existing DICOM Part and DICOM PS 3.18 WADO links.

related_jiras.note: Later WADO-RS rendering intro request for ImagingStudy/ImagingObjectSelection was resolved no-change because prior CPs already handled it.
